name: gtmos-ops
description: Internal GTMOS operations for Tam To Target: client data, lead loading, DNC and ops checks over the /api/mcp/ops server. What you can do follows your token: superadmin sees every tool, a GTM-write token sees reads plus data-plane writes, a read token sees reads.

gtmos_api_token.title: GTMOS API token
gtmos_api_token.description: Your personal token from GTMOS → Settings → API tokens (sdr_live_…). Use the GTM-write token if you load leads or DNC; superadmins use their admin token. Stored in secure storage.

gtmos_url.title: GTMOS URL
gtmos_url.description: Base URL of GTMOS. Change only to point at a staging deploy.
